verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's evidence shows only adjacent features. Webhooks push notifications to Discord or Slack when a response is ready, and external services can post messages into Open WebUI channels. Neither lets a user hold a conversation with the assistant from WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack or iMessage. The PWA and the API key are another surface and a developer building block, not messenger integrations.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can talk to my assistant from the messengers I already use — WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or iMessage — not just a bespoke web page
